title: Sunday · Washington plates
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The arc's Sunday: Gully's lot from the dock, a clean car with Washington plates parked wrong, two figures at the counter through the window who don't order. Wood not there; the strip drawn from Gully's account.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the gravel lot at Gully's from the dock, a clean gray car with Washington plates parked across two spaces, the shack, the corkboard through the window.

panels.name: Lot

panels.composition: Tier 2: through the window: two figures in good coats at the counter, not sitting, not ordering, one holding a folder. Gully behind the counter with his arms crossed.

panels.composition: Tier 3: the lot, the car gone, two tire ruts in the gravel, the dock, the end stool visible through the open door with nobody on it. Held.
